reviewed_by: SELF-REVIEW by seat 1/3 — the seat that wrote the code. NOT an independent verdict. Design advice came from a Fable advisor agent, which is advice, not a review.

asked_for_by.verbatim: there is to big wait after starting a run. is it possible to stream the responces to the dashboard as they come in. like a little visual flare. would love to see like the thought processes streaming thought. then colapsing into a expandable window. get a fable advisor to help

what_it_is_not: NOT provider token streaming. ADR-017's stream:false stands: the whole response body is scanned for the credential before anything reaches the record. Within one call there is still a wait; the lane is honest about it rather than filling it.

interfaces.precedent: ADR-019 decision 2 (real time = observation of committed evidence by cursor polling) and the existing study.start poll in app.js

measurement_that_the_feature_rests_on.how: a real local ollama run driven through WorkroomService on a temporary state root, polling runs.list and run.get concurrently
measurement_that_the_feature_rests_on.observed: run_created and model_request committed at t+0.4s; model_response, decision_invalid, run_finished at t+28.3s; the run visible in the inventory at t+0.4s with status running; run.get served fine mid-flight
measurement_that_the_feature_rests_on.conclusion: events are committed individually (begin_write per write, WAL), so a browser can follow a run live with no server change

verified_live.how: a real browser against a throwaway state root on a spare port (127.0.0.1:8792); the operator's own state was never touched
observed: the waiting state appears on model_request and clears on model_response
reasoning opens beside the decision and collapses when the next step opens; exact content stays collapsed
a provider error ends the step with its typed code and no retry language
the poll advances its cursor 0 to 5 across two ticks and reaches BOUNDARY REACHED
a launch that settles with no terminal event stops reading and reports UNCONFIRMED
defects_found_by_this_testing_and_fixed_: the finish line reused the pulsing wait style and was then swept by the wait-clearing pass
the poll stopped the moment the launch settled, which could drop events committed just before it returned and never show the boundary

measured.note: unchanged from the previous tip: the lane is browser-only and the Python suite does not exercise it.

not_claimed: the browser harness was NOT executed by this seat; the lane's assertions were added and syntax-checked only, and the live verification above was performed directly through a browser instead
the lane is not a provider stream and does not reduce the time any single model call takes
